briefings.title: From Restoring Sight to Reimagining the Brain, with Max Hodak
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Max Hodak, co-founder and CEO of Science Corporation, discusses the company's mission to treat the brain as a computational system—highlighting the commercial approval of their PRIMA retinal implant in Europe and their long-term vision of achieving substrate independence.
